provider.attribution: Live race data is pulled from NBC News result feeds where NBC exposes a matching race. CivicAPI is used only for covered races NBC does not expose directly. Race calls are manual Federal Elections Analysis calls from local config.
provider.estimatedVoteReporting: Estimated-in percentages come from NBC News percent-in fields or NBC statewide fallback fields where available.
